## What needs review?

Describe the suspected issue and why the current reading may be wrong.

## Explorer context

Include the glyph ID, permalink, observed pattern, and any relevant source-frame references. The explorer's report link fills these in automatically.

## Supporting evidence

Link to public, permitted evidence or describe how to reproduce the observation. Do not upload copyrighted source video unless you have permission.
